requirement_text.REQ-395:
Deploy SwiftRoute's sequential high-value shipment-approval process definition as a live, browsable definition on a real tenant. SCOPE: (1) Create persistent live ProcessDefinition for swiftroute tenant on QA instance matching process_route_approval.yaml graph; (2) Confirm reachable via ordinary API; (3) Out of scope: new Keycloak identities.
AC1: ProcessDefinition exists live on QA, confirmed via definitions-list API.
AC2: Instance with declared_value: 750 → pending ops-review task, then pending ceo-approval task.
AC3: Instance with declared_value: 400 → no ceo-approval task.
AC4: [DEFERRED to after ISS-0739]

issues.detail: §1 specifies `GET /api/v1/definitions/active/Shipment%20Approval` for the idempotency pre-flight, but this path-segment form is not cited in the router spec (only `POST /:id/activate` is cited from definitions.ex). The AC1 verification in §4.1 uses the list endpoint `GET /api/v1/definitions?name=Shipment+Approval&status=active`. ELIXIR-DEV must confirm the path-segment form exists before writing the curl call, or substitute the list-endpoint form. This is a script pre-flight detail, not a design ambiguity.
